sections.prompt_context: Generate 8-12 numbered paragraphs for an Anticipatory Bail application under Section 482 BNSS. Paragraph 1 must mention FIR No. {fir_number} dated {fir_date}, registered at PS {police_station}, under Sections {sections_charged} of BNS, 2023. State that the applicant APPREHENDS arrest and has NOT been arrested yet. Paragraphs 2-4 should narrate the facts: {facts_narrative}. Subsequent paragraphs should establish grounds: {grounds_for_bail}. Include reference to: (i) Article 21 of Constitution, (ii) Sushila Aggarwal v. State (2020) 5 SCC 1 on conditions for anticipatory bail, (iii) that custodial interrogation is not necessary as applicant is willing to join investigation. Do NOT generate the prayer clause or verification — those are template-handled.
